output.summary: Deciduous or semi-deciduous trees native to Europe and distributed across much of the Northern Hemisphere, Ulmus has toothed leaves that are usually uneven at the base and lightweight, round winged fruits. During Norway’s 1812 famine, boiled strips of elm bark sustained much of the rural population; the seeds are also described as especially nutritious.
